svg.aria-label: A retains pure-water viscosity values from Hackley and Clogston, NIST SP1200-6, p. 9. B computes an unchanged 80 nm particle with correct temperature but a fixed erroneous viscosity input 0.890 mPa·s. C is a conceptual hydrodynamic-equivalence diagram, not to scale.
